metrics.query: cve_records WHERE attributed_to = 'lanternfish-security' AND state = 'PUBLISHED' AND datePublished IN (2024-07-06T12:00:00.000Z, 2026-07-06T12:00:00Z] AND id NOT IN exclusions -> containers.cna.problemTypes[].descriptions[].cweId (placeholders counted: false)

cve_records WHERE attributed_to = 'lanternfish-security' AND state = 'PUBLISHED' AND datePublished IN (2024-07-06T12:00:00.000Z, 2026-07-06T12:00:00Z] AND id NOT IN exclusions -> cna.cwe usable AND cna.cpe well-formed AND cpe.vendor IN cpe_vendor_aliases('lanternfish-security')
